{{Quote|Leave him alone. They kept him in his growth jar too long.|Cutup, defending Echo from Hevy|<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:CloneTanks-NEGWT.png|thumb|right|300px|Growth jars in a cloning chamber]]
'''Growth jars''' were [[cloning tank]]s used by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] in the [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities to grow the embryos of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were situated along disk-shaped [[Kamino cloning chamber|cloning chambers]] that were attached to large pillars in the [[Egg Lab/Legends|Egg Lab]]<ref name="Ep2">{{Film|II}}</ref> and the [[Tipoca City embryo room/Legends|Tipoca City embryo room]].<ref name="Fugitive">{{TCW|Fugitive}}</ref> The embryos were kept in there until they were old enough to be released.<ref name="Ep2" />

{{Tech-stub}}

==History==
When the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] were hired to produce a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], they used growth jars to contain embryos in order to mass-produce clones of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] for the Republic.<ref name="Ep2" />

When the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Hevy]] and [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], who were stationed on an [[Rishi Station/Legends|outpost]] on the [[Rishi moon]] among other clones were having an argument, their companion [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]] jokingly referred to Echo's distaste for excitement by saying that they kept him in his growth jar too long.<ref name="Rookies" />
